1. Give two things that determine the quantity and distance that eroded material can go. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown: 1. **The size and mass of the particles, and the speed at which the eroding agent (water, wind or glacial ice) is moving** together determine how much material is moved and how far it travels.

3. What is sheet erosion? (0.5 mark)
questions.corrige_markdown: 3. **Sheet erosion is the process by which a thin sheet of water flowing across the soil surface carries away dislodged soil particles.**

4. How do human activities affect rates of erosion? (1.5 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown: 4. **Human activities that remove natural vegetation — farming, logging and construction — leave the soil unprotected, so it is much more easily carried away by wind and water, which greatly accelerates erosion.** As a result, rivers today carry an estimated 24 trillion kg of sediment to the oceans each year, compared to about 9 trillion kg before humans appeared.

5. Soil erosion brings about some negative effects. Name two of them. (1 mark)
questions.corrige_markdown: 5. **(1)** Lower agricultural productivity and poorer crop quality caused by the loss of fertile topsoil. **(2)** The deposition of sediment in rivers and reservoirs, which reduces their usefulness for storing water, controlling floods and generating electricity, and which can also carry contaminating agricultural pesticides.

questions.corrige_markdown: 6. **(1)** Planting rows of trees called windbreaks. **(2)** Terracing hillsides. **(3)** Ploughing along the contours of hills. **(4)** Rotating crops.

7. Do you think that there is a problem of erosion in Cameroon? Suggest two ways to solve this problem. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown: 7. **Réponse personnelle**, par exemple : oui, l'érosion est un problème réel au Cameroun, notamment dans les zones de forte pente et les régions déboisées pour l'agriculture. Deux solutions possibles : encourager les agriculteurs à pratiquer la culture en terrasses et le labour en courbes de niveau sur les collines, et mettre en place des programmes de reboisement pour restaurer la couverture végétale des sols dégradés.
